summary_en: Misawa & Co. authorized acquisition of up to 50,000 shares (0.70% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for up to 35 million yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from September 15, 2026 to April 30, 2027, to fund restricted stock awards for directors and employees.
title_en: Notice on Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: Misawa & Co. announced on September 14, 2026, that its board of directors has authorized the acquisition of treasury stock to fund restricted stock awards for eligible directors and employees. The company will purchase up to 50,000 ordinary shares, representing 0.70% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock as of August 31, 2026), for an aggregate amount not exceeding 35 million yen. The acquisition will be conducted through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from September 15, 2026, through April 30, 2027. This authorization is made pursuant to Article 165(2) of the Companies Act, with the acquisition method specified as open market purchases. The company holds 8,636 treasury shares as of the reference date, with 7,103,764 shares outstanding excluding treasury stock.
